lines.text: Four hours booked on the shredder, under a name that has never worked in this building, starting in forty minutes.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: The week after somebody reads the 2031 paper register for the first time in thirty years. I am not a suspicious person. I once filled in a form about a broken kettle. And I am suspicious.

choices.text: Paper is not the point. They have copies.
